failure.body:
test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py runs 3 testlets which are all failing on T2 topologies:
config_reload_with_config_save
config_reload_no_config_save
reboot

E.G. `config_reload_with_config_save`
```
> /data/tests/voq/test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py(170)test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency()
-> "DB_Consistency Failed")
```

Each of these testcases have their own timeout values.
config_reload_with_config_save (180s)
```
169             pytest_assert(wait_until(180, 30, 0, check_db_consistency, duthosts, duthost, init_dump),
170                           "DB_Consistency Failed")
```
config_reload_no_config_save (180s)
```
174             pytest_assert(wait_until(180, 30, 0, check_db_consistency, duthosts, duthost, post_change_db_dump),
175                           "DB_Consistency Failed")
```
reboot (380s)
```
185             pytest_assert(wait_until(380, 30, 0, check_db_consistency, duthosts, duthost, init_dump),
186                           "DB_Consistency Failed After Reboot")
```

I tried increasing these timeouts to 600s and then repeated the test and saw it passed, indicating we aren't waiting long enough for the DB to converge after config reload and reboot.

E.G. from the logs I can see testcase config_reload_with_config_save takes between 295-325s
```
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0143 DEBUG  | check_db_consistency is False, wait 30 seconds and check again
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0125 DEBUG  | Time elapsed: 262.709992 seconds
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0143 DEBUG  | check_db_consistency is False, wait 30 seconds and check again
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0125 DEBUG  | Time elapsed: 295.342030 seconds
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0140 DEBUG  | check_db_consistency is True, exit early with True
```

We see these failures started around November which was when this test was introduced:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/10218

resolution.title: test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py: Increase timeout of config reload and reboot
resolution.description:
All 3 testcases in `test_voq_chassis_app_db_consistency.py` were failing due to not waiting long enough after config reload or reboot on T2 topologies.

This PR increases the timeout amount to 600s, which seemed sufficient for all 3 test cases on multiple T2 setups.
E.G.
`config_reload_with_config_save & config_reload_no_config_save`
```
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0143 DEBUG  | check_db_consistency is False, wait 30 seconds and check again
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0125 DEBUG  | Time elapsed: 262.709992 seconds
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0143 DEBUG  | check_db_consistency is False, wait 30 seconds and check again
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0125 DEBUG  | Time elapsed: 295.342030 seconds
11/01/2024 <IPV6> utilities.wait_until                     L0140 DEBUG  | check_db_consistency is True, exit early with True
```

`Reboot`
```

```
